title: Fanren simulator: REAL/SIM prices, run state and later source corrections
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: later review supersession, transaction scope and unresolved source discrepancy
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers300input lines, W1–W4/42369character units/20selected chapters,24coordinator-check groups, all facility/role/money/clock/source-gap rows, F1–F12/EF1–EF10/C1–C10/five floor cards and later independent W2/W3 addenda. The fan novel title is distinct from the original Fanren novel and from five other TTKS titles. The supplied Traditional-script mirror JSON SHA d522bf1595ac71b3843f9a41a9b96a26d8b47e55ac22ecafe949b4ceec2c2a31 is a44chapter partial capture;184total and creator/platform are secondary metadata. The dated tried-mirror outcome does not prove no other source exists or current global unavailability. No new acquisition, raw chapter/body read or whole-source verification occurs.

F2: Later section17 supersedes the earlier resolved-C4 statement: off-island investigation assurances, elders' behavior and unavenged ambush retain an open stated-rule/practice tension. Open sea is not a safe zone against other actors. C3distinguishes25years in town from a separate40year ordeal run; do not merge them into one lifespan cost. The table's age21/66 and other age16/19/17 shorthand need the exact run/event crosswalk before deriving a timeline. The later500/470/750caps are per-run values, not a fixed500global meter. Cross-reference slips are corrected to C2fee/C4avenging/C6Qi6threshold without renumbering original IDs.

F3: Start charge, tier draw, reward claim fee, extra-pick cap cost, listed bag and received contents are separate transactions. Section17 confirms a2000reward-fee line at0010p19 while the following1000line's object remains unresolved; the deep dive's blanket inferred-claim-fee gap is qualified with that reused review. First-free/all-rewards is a source exception, not a policy demanding free first runs everywhere. A listed2000versusreceived1000+gap has no established cause; it does not authorize inventing a tax. REAL versus SIM labels, believed20000/recruiter30000/coreglut5000, sold total versus per-core arithmetic, shouted offer versus paid price, pre-auction700000proceeds versus lot bids, and one-way2000teleport all retain state and unit. Claimed currency identity does not itself transfer purchasing power across real/run boundaries.

F4: Raw reward realm differs from learned understanding, actual stabilization, fuel/calm support, mind state and observer-visible breakthrough. A specific context-dependent bloodlust does not prove every reward secretly misfires. A binding clock/obedience claim is not proof killing a provider reverses already acquired effects or all completed control; preserve actual support and aftermath questions under BHR32. Same-realm predation, Qi6threshold, actual later joining, patron exemption and local brawl policy are source-specific motives, not universal sect or rank permissions. A nod-through with no fee shown is not proof no fee exists. Source quantities/forced source situations do not become new player policies.

F5: A forecast keyed to known canon and choices does not make the live world immune to divergence or an omniscient external calendar; actor knowledge and forecast source need SA19/AD9 scope. Real cooldown, zero-time run narration, simulated lived years, real closed cultivation and institutional deadlines remain independent clocks. Nested mortal run and post-run cultivation intervals need their own labels. Later proposed host checkpoint/rewind/carry seams are historical source-reading claims, not fresh current implementation or save proof. Retire the one-realm milestone phrase against current PROJECT; price/tier/menu/cap/context are useful candidate fields, not a compulsory minimal schema or a mandatory misfire. Preserve named source gaps and the unresolved reward/realm discrepancy, without a purchase, worker launch or new runtime gate.
reviews.evidence: All300lines read in four untruncated chunks, simulator owner678–758 and selected deep dive30–66; supporting owner review is scoped. No new source-body or code/behavior verification.
reviews.reopen: Keep run-local identity and unresolved fees/realm/age/institution contradictions; selected runtime work needs current producer/state/consumer and actual proof.
